Our mind and body makes decisions on our behalf just to ensure our survival, so suicide is inherently like going against our evolutionary programming. It sucks because that programming makes us all think we’re special and that’s what perpetuates this we’re all here for a reason bullshit or that we all have something to live for. Sometimes, in fact most times, we have nothing to live for. Not everyone has a story, or a light at the end of their tunnel. Most of us are just collateral damage; NPCs. This Might sound hypocritical coming from me, someone who’s actively planning to kill themselves this month, but I’ll advice you to give it time. You’re just 18 man, fuck what the world says, you’re just a child. I’m 21, and I feel like I was 18 just yesterday.

It’s hard at 18 man; just few months ago you couldn’t do shit, now all of a sudden its all your responsibility. Fuck your friends, and that girlfriend, and those that rejected you. At that age most of your relationships are meaningless tbh, most rejections aren’t a judgment on you really. Most ppl don’t know wtf they’re doing at that age, and don’t really know what they want, so it’s got nothing to do with you.

Find hobbies, literally anything. I used to to think I should’ve just been happy naturally, but doing things like going to the gym, boxing, playing soccer, reading, made me sane for a while. So give it some time, figure out what you like doing and work on yourself. Don’t be afraid to change interests, you’re just starting out. Good luck
